title: Naya context, purani aadat: kya badal sakta hai?
topic: Habit discontinuity after a major context change
claim_classification: Habit-theory evidence plus observational, field and intentional-habit findings; not a universal behaviour-change guarantee.
key_claim_boundaries: A context change can make a previously cue-linked routine more open to deliberate reconsideration; it does not automatically remove a habit.
The home-move and commuting finding is limited to its travel context and observational/field evidence.
Stable context supported automaticity during intentional study-habit formation; this does not prove that every disrupted habit disappears.
A context change can also interrupt helpful routines.
